from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ReportDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single data point (month and value) extracted from a specific report."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The period the housing completions cover (YYYY-MM)")
    saar_value: float | None = Field(description="The seasonally adjusted annual rate for completions")
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this report was published (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    report_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the report/document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    data_points: list[ReportDataPoint]
